Title: Umbuntu.Automate.ManualTriggerInput
Description: Run Umbraco Automate automations by hand and give them input. Adds a Manual Trigger (with Input) and a "Run with input…" backoffice action: editors type or paste text, such as a URL or a JSON object, and every step in the automation can use it as ${trigger.triggerInput}.
